## Checklist

- [ ] `composer check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the logic that changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] If anything is now sent to TypeSafe that was not before, `== External services ==` in `readme.txt` says so
- [ ] If a development file was added to the repo root, it is in `.distignore`
- [ ] No design decision in `CLAUDE.md` is reversed (or the PR says which one and why)
- [ ] No version bump (releases are separate; see `docs/RELEASING.md`)
